name: Acceptor Currency Conversion Request V 13
definition: The AcceptorCurrencyConversionRequest message is sent by the card acceptor to the currency conversion service provider to request if the cardholder is able to pay in the currency of its card.

Header.definition: Currency Conversion request message management information.

CurrencyConversionRequest.name: Currency Conversion Request
CurrencyConversionRequest.definition: Information related to the currency conversion request.
